description: This file implements the cert_verifier component of the net namespace, including class definitions, factory functions, and verification logic related to SSL/TLS certificate verification.

classes.name: DefaultCertVerifyProcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating certificate verification procedures, with logic depending on build flags.

methods.name: CreateCertVerifyProc
methods.description: Creates a certificate verification procedure based on build flags and parameters.

methods.name: RequestParams
methods.description: Holds parameters for a certificate verification request, including a hash key for caching.

methods.name: CreateDefaultWithoutCaching
methods.description: Creates a CertVerifier with verification procedures, without caching.

methods.name: CreateDefault
methods.description: Creates a CertVerifier with caching and coalescing.
